name: comp-307

frames.best_why: Frame 3 shows the whole strip and all three controls with the cursor well below them.
frames.render_note: The crop cuts the left edge, so the leading icon and the opening words are missing.

tagline: Thin launch bar offers a Download button and a dismiss X.
summary: A full-width dark strip announcing a launch, with a white Download button, a plain Learn more link and a close X that hides the bar.
appearance: A very thin, full-width dark band sits at the top, holding one small line of light text on the left. On the right are a white rounded Download button, a borderless Learn more label and a faint X.
behaviour: Pressing the X removes the band. Learn more underlines and the X brightens on hover; the demo never presses Download.
demo_content: It's live and ready to use! Start exploring the latest addition to your toolkit.
search_phrases: full width update message with buttons
promo strip with download and close
use_when: You want a slim launch announcement with a primary download action and a dismiss control.
avoid_when: The message and buttons are fixed and dismissal is not stored, so the bar returns on reload.
customise: The message, button labels and targets are fixed in the file; only the visible flag is local state.
weight_why: A single thin band with one state flag and a hover transition.

a11y.note: Close is labelled and icons are hidden, but the file adds no focus style of its own and ignores reduced motion.

issues: The clip crops the left edge, cutting the leading icon and opening words.
Download and Learn more have no handlers, so neither action does anything.
polish_why: Tidy, compact launch strip; cropped edge and inert buttons keep it ordinary.
